seriesName: US data center power demand forecast (Goldman Sachs Research)
notes: This series contextualizes the bullet's $110B/45GW-by-2030 power buildout claim by showing the shorter-run trajectory of US data center power demand (2025-2027) that is driving that investment. Figures are Goldman Sachs Research forecasts as reported by Data Centre Digest (datacentredigest.com) on 2026-07-06; all three points come from the same article/page, quoted verbatim as 'a move from 31 GW in 2025 to 41 GW in 2026 and 66 GW in 2027.' These are forecast/projection numbers, not actuals -- presented here as a published forecast, not as a measured outcome. Could not use S&P Global 451 Research or Goldman Sachs' own site directly, as both returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to an automated fetch.
